newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIMEX Brent lower, drops into old trading range.
newsitem.headline: SIMEX Brent lower, drops into old trading range.

text.p: Crude futures in Asia stayed weak into late trading on Friday as overnight losses and a continued correction of the recent rally was extended.
March Brent was last traded at $22.83 per barrel, down 24 cents from London and at the intraday low.
March fell 58 cents to $23.07 in London.
NYMEX February crude was last traded at $25.30 per barrel on the after-hours ACCESS system, down 22 cents from New York and just above the intraday low.
Brokers said sentiment on NYMEX heating oil was leading the futures complex as distillates seemed to have mostly made up a year-on-year shortfall in stocks in the U.S.
February heating oil dropped 1.50 cent to 69.92 cents per gallon in New York and extended the loss to 69.50 on ACCESS.

Brokers said the Brent action on SIMEX had filled a small front-month chart gap between $22.95 and $22.91 and left prices in the middle of the October-to-late-December trading range of $23.40 to $21.40 indicating a period of steady trading near term.
